And "moral superiority" is just code for "I'm too weak to admit my own biases and prejudices". By the way, I'm still waiting for you to actually present a coherent argument, instead of just throwing out ad homs and emotional manipulation.

I'm curious to hear the details of this plan to take away women's rights and give the state more power over our lives.

You're using buzzwords like 'women's rights' to sound progressive, but really you're just advocating for the state to limit the choices of one specific group. Your focus on your own moral superiority makes it hard to see the hypocrisy in your position.
